summary: Three key documents produced for the UNESCO pitch: (1) completed working paper whitepaper.md (5,314 words, 39KB) — all 9 sections filled with technical details from the codebase (127 opcodes, 360-word map, compilation flow, Codex steps 1-20, RBR deployment); (2) UNESCO executive summary (808 words) — framed for an individual not an organisation with €16k–€28k Stage 1 ask; (3) Validation roadmap (1,046 words) — 8-week plan for FR/DE/IT with criteria, validator brief, risk matrix.
